newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile blue chips end softer, focus on Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: Chile blue chips end softer, focus on Fed meeting.

text.p: Chilean blue chip stocks tumbled to close at a new year low of 88.74 points with shares seen opening stable as investors wait for the outcome of the Federal Reserve monthly meeting Tuesday, said traders.
"I don't see great changes tomorrow. Everyone will be waiting to see if the Fed changes U.S. interest rates," said one dealer.
The selective index ended unofficially down 0.44 percent at 88.74 points. The general index slipped 0.02 percent to 4,908.51 points.
Endesa closed off 0.28 percent at 217-2/5 pesos.
The bolsa was dragged down by slides in Chilean-issued American Depositary Receipts which reflected Wall Street's retreat in late trade, said traders.
Decliners included telecoms company Telex which plunged 7.32 percent to 4-3/4. Its stock dropped in Santiago 4.81 percent to 990 pesos.
Traders said they did not know the reason for the fall, but added that the stock is lightly traded so any sale immediately hurts the share price.
